purpose: Show the exact major cardiovascular endpoint results from the corrected PREDIMED republication, Lyon Diet Heart Study and CORDIOPREV while preventing false cross-trial magnitude comparisons.
title: Three endpoint trials support cardiovascular benefit
story: The corrected 2018 PREDIMED republication reported fewer primary composite events with extra-virgin olive oil and nuts than with low-fat advice.
The Lyon Diet Heart Study reported 14 versus 44 cardiac deaths or nonfatal myocardial infarctions after myocardial infarction.
CORDIOPREV reported 87 versus 111 major cardiovascular events among patients with established coronary disease.
Populations, endpoints, comparators and follow-up differ, so magnitudes must not be compared across panels.

panel_a.population: High cardiovascular risk; n=7,447; median 4.8 years
panel_a.endpoint: Myocardial infarction, stroke or cardiovascular death

panel_b.endpoint: Cardiac death or nonfatal myocardial infarction

observed: All values are reported trial endpoint results.
The original 2013 PREDIMED report is retracted; only the corrected 2018 republication is used.
inferred: The three panels jointly support cardiovascular benefit, but their distinct endpoints and designs do not identify a single pooled effect.
layout_notes: Use three vertically aligned open panels labelled a, b and c, separated by thin grey hairlines on a white 3:2 landscape canvas; do not use cards or filled panel backgrounds.
Panel a uses an exact linear hazard-ratio axis from 0.4 to 1.2, with a thin vertical reference line at 1.0 and proportional dot-and-whisker geometry.
Panels b and c show paired event counts as direct black numerals with equal-size row marks; row area and numeral size must not encode magnitude.
Place the cross-panel warning and retraction note as compact black text beneath the panels.
constraints: Arial throughout; all labels at least 18 px at a 1536 px canvas width.
Every dot and confidence interval endpoint in panel a must be proportional to the supplied axis.
Do not derive or display unreported event rates for panels b or c.
Do not compare bar lengths or areas across panels.
Keep the title outside the artwork because this is an article figure.
The original 2013 PREDIMED report must be labelled retracted and must not appear as supporting evidence.
